sentences.en: I had an artificial insemination with sperm from my husband.
sentences.zh: 我用丈夫的精子进行了人工授精。

sentences.en: The first space stations rotated axially to produce artificial gravity.
sentences.zh: 早期的空间站通过旋转产生人造重力。

sentences.en: Now that there's artificial intelligence, your own intelligence is irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 有了人工智能之后，你自己的智力就无关紧要了。

senses.zh: 人造的, 人工的, 假的 - 虚假的, 不真挚的, 矫揉造作的 - 人为的
